result.markdown:
# Nationwide Latency and Core DNS Degradation Incident

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** core_degradation at `CORE-DNS-01`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence of query success percentage drop and resolution time spikes on CORE-DNS-01 matching the timeline of the nationwide latency anomaly, with configuration changes and maintenance windows checked and ruled out on the node and its parents.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-24 10:45 to 2026-09-24 12:05
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-24 10:45
- **Affected:** CORE-DNS-01, S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-003, S-SAH-004, S-SUD-002

## Summary

Core DNS degradation on CORE-DNS-01 causing nationwide latency and resolution failure spikes.

Nationwide latency complaints and anomalies involving 48 sites and CORE-DNS-01 between 10:45 and 12:05 on 2026-09-24.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-24 10:45: Nationwide latency anomaly and earliest KPI deviation onset detected. [T1, T2, ALR-0035, T8]
- 2026-09-24 10:52: Major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE alarm raised on CORE-DNS-01. [T3, ALM-000525]
- 2026-09-24 11:30: Worst query success percentage drop (92.7%) and maximum resolution time (88.7 ms) recorded on CORE-DNS-01. [T8, ANM-000322]
- 2026-09-24 12:00: KPI recovery observed on CORE-DNS-01 and national metrics. [T2, T8]
- 2026-09-24 12:05: DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE alarm cleared on CORE-DNS-01, concluding the incident impact. [T3, ALM-000525]

## Evidence

- Nationwide latency deviation and anomaly ALR-0035 started at 10:45 on 2026-09-24. [T1, T2, ALR-0035]
- CORE-DNS-01 experienced a query_success_pct drop to 92.7% and a resolution_ms increase to 88.7 ms starting at 10:45 on 2026-09-24. [T8, ANM-000322]
- Major alarm ALM-000525 for DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE was raised on CORE-DNS-01 at 10:52 and cleared at 12:05. [T3, ALM-000525]
- No relevant changes or maintenance windows occurred on CORE-DNS-01 or its parents during the incident window. [T5, T6]

## Hypotheses

1. **core_degradation** at CORE-DNS-01: confirmed. Direct core KPIs on CORE-DNS-01 showed significant degradation starting at 10:45, aligning perfectly with the nationwide latency anomaly and accompanied by a major DNS timeout alarm. [T3, T8, ALR-0035, ALM-000525]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SUD-02-A: rejected. The minor link degraded alarm ALM-000524 on LNK-SUD-02-A cleared well before the incident impact started and was isolated, whereas the DNS failure directly matches nationwide symptoms. [T3, ALM-000524]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000524: Raised on 2026-09-24 09:05 and cleared at 09:21, which is prior to the onset of the nationwide latency impact at 10:45.
- CHG-2026-0063: Occurred at 2026-09-24 12:52 on S-TUN-007, which is after the incident had already recovered.

## Recommended actions

- Investigate the underlying cause of the temporary DNS processing slowdown on CORE-DNS-01.
- Review resource allocation and capacity limits for core name resolution servers during peak utilization.

## Sources

- `T1`: get_anomalies(start=2026-09-24 04:00, end=2026-09-25 09:14) -> 1 detector alert(s) overlap 2026-09-24 04:00 to 2026-09-25 09:14.

- `ALR-0035`: ended alert from 2026-09-24 10:45: 48 site(s) (S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-003, S-SAH-004 +44 more); core CORE-DNS-01; region-level SAH, SFX, SUD, TUN; metrics: dl_vol...
- `T8`: query_kpis(entity_type=core_node, entity_ids=['CORE-DNS-01'], metrics=['query_success_pct', 'resolution_ms'], start=2026-09-24 08:00, end=2026-09-24 1 -> Deviation in 2 of 2 series. Earliest onset 2026-09-24 10:45: CORE-DNS-01 query_success_pct below baseline.
- `T3`: get_alarms(start=2026-09-24 08:00, end=2026-09-24 13:00, include_descendants=True, min_severity=minor) -> 2 alarm(s) on any node, 2026-09-24 08:00 to 2026-09-24 13:00: 1 major, 1 minor; 0 active at asked_at (2026-09-25 09:14).
- `ALM-000525`: major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE on CORE-DNS-01, raised 2026-09-24 10:52, cleared 2026-09-24 12:05
- `ANM-000322`: CORE-DNS-01 query_success_pct drop, z -65.9, baseline 99.9 -> 92.7
- `T5`: get_changes(start=2026-09-24 08:00, end=2026-09-24 13:00, node_ids=['CORE-DNS-01'], include_ancestors=True) -> No changes on CORE-DNS-01 and its parents between 2026-09-24 08:00 and 2026-09-24 13:00.
- `T6`: get_maintenance(start=2026-09-24 08:00, end=2026-09-24 13:00, node_ids=['CORE-DNS-01'], include_ancestors=True) -> No maintenance window scheduled on CORE-DNS-01 and its parents between 2026-09-24 08:00 and 2026-09-24 13:00.
